title: Concept: Podfile.lock with no `SPEC CHECKSUMS` block
description: Podfile.lock declares a lockfile that records no pod checksums, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile.lock (cocoapods).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
